note: model_class: online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file using the global RNG (the evaluator calls it after set_seed). This file records the fixed shape family of get_inputs as the machine-readable version of the task contract; spatial_shapes is regenerated each round from randint[1,16), n_keys and the value shape are derived from it, and the out shape does not depend on spatial_shapes; see task.yaml for the tolerance and the global shape constraints. The hidden/perf cases are dicts of {name + semantic fields}: name is a metadata key, and after the consumer strips it the remaining semantic fields are passed to reference.py::make_inputs(**fields) for deterministic generation.

shape_family.spatial_shapes: randint[1,16) redrawn every round, each row (H_l, W_l); n_keys = sum H_l*W_l
shape_family.out_layout: contiguous (N, Q, heads*D); naturally a single-tensor output, no multi-output packing
